messages.text:
The built SSR server is failing before the browser can connect because my server entry used an older `createStartHandler({ createRouter })` shape.

This Start version loads `getRouter` from the router entry automatically, so I’m simplifying the server entry to the current default handler form and rerunning build plus e2e.
